LIS.saveTip: At Café A Brasileira, standing at the counter is the cheapest option; the terrace costs the most.

cheapEat.name: Pratos do dia (today's menu)
cheapEat.note: Set menu with soup, main, dessert, house wine and coffee; €7–10 a person.

OPO.saveTip: Prioridade Bar in Ribeira is one of the cheapest places for a large beer, at only a few euros.

cheapEat.name: Menu of the day, Restaurante Travessa
cheapEat.note: Generous servings and a good variety; €11 menu of the day (2024 listing).

FAO.saveTip: Buy picnic food at the Faro Municipal Market, where the underground supermarket opens daily 08:00–20:30.

cheapEat.name: Picado (beef steak with chips)
cheapEat.note: Restaurante Beer Garden; the €10 normal size is enough for two.

FNC.saveTip: Share one normal-size Picado between two people; the listing says €10 is enough for two.

cheapEat.name: Pizza al taglio (by the slice)
cheapEat.note: About €2 a slice, per the Wikivoyage Rome Eat section.

ROM.saveTip: Buy pizza al taglio by the slice (about €2) rather than a lunch set menu, which costs €15–20.

cheapEat.name: Dumplings at La Ravioleria Sarpi
cheapEat.note: Chinese dumplings, takeaway only; 4 for €3 (2018 listing price).

MIL.saveTip: Go to Bar Magenta for aperitivo around 19:00, when free appetizers are given out.

cheapEat.name: Cicchetti (Venetian bar snacks)
cheapEat.note: Pile a plate at Cantine del Vino già Schiavi; listed at €2–3 (2024).

VCE.saveTip: At Bacareto da Lele a small glass of wine costs one euro; queuing at the bar is normal.

cheapEat.name: Pizza margherita, L'Antica Pizzeria da Michele
cheapEat.note: Pizza and soft drink together, €6–7; queues are usual.

NAP.saveTip: Pizza and soft drink at L'Antica Pizzeria da Michele cost €6–7, under the €15 cheap-meal price.

BLQ.saveTip: Eat lunch at Tamburini, a reasonably priced self-service, or at Mercato di Mezzo, which has good prices.

cheapEat.name: Panino at I fratellini
cheapEat.note: Panini €5 (March 2024 price); patrons eat on the sidewalk.

FLR.saveTip: At I fratellini you can eat on the sidewalk with your wine, which was listed from €2 (2018 price).
